scope: camera_pose_only; two official SampleSet scenes; not canonical DTU dense MVS evaluation

conditions.interpretation: wider index spacing; overlap not guaranteed

metrics.auc_definition: exact integral of empirical recall: mean(max(0,1-error/threshold)); missing pairs contribute zero; joint error=max(rotation,oriented_translation)
metrics.success: prediction status success AND all input cameras available; not an accuracy threshold
metrics.partial: 2 or more cameras but fewer than inputs; retain coverage and subset errors
metrics.ate: evaluation-only Sim3, mm, >=3 noncollinear registered centers
metrics.aggregation: per-scene-condition rows; means and medians separately dev/test; pairs not pooled across unequal view counts
metrics.dense: not evaluated: no matched dense MVS baseline; not DTU official dense accuracy/completeness
